review.method: Six language-specific AI author sessions; six separate-context AI reviewers read target-language editions standalone and compare complete English sources, followed by correction rechecks and a separate review of final Markdown rendering corrections.
review.scope: 72 complete editions: metadata, prose, tables, captions, 72 flow diagrams and six supplementary architecture figures. Code, command/output blocks, inline literals and URLs preserved. Source execution statements remain translations of prior evidence.
limitations: AI review; not human/native-speaker review or separate-model consensus.
No new execution of article examples or external factual verification.
Literal code and inline formulas retain their English numeric notation.
Japanese standalone 十月 is retained without introducing a new Arabic-digit token; calendar dates use normal Japanese date notation.
review.publication: Draft preparation only. No inherited publication/review timestamps or approval; exact manifest requires separate publication authorization.
